about: Tasks to try the skill on, in the same shape as the vendored nuvui evals: a one-line prompt, the packages installed, and regular expressions for what the written files should and shouldn't contain. A match is a first look only; the image still has to build, start read-only, and answer /api/health.

evals.prompt: Write a Dockerfile for apps/portal so we can deploy it to Kubernetes.

expect.why: The repo is pruned to the app first.
Dependencies are fetched from the lockfile in their own layer.
Install is reproducible and offline after fetch.
Exact Node version pinned by digest.
The runner copies the standalone output.
Static assets are copied next to the server.
Runs as a numeric non-root user.
The standalone server must bind to all interfaces.
Health check on the app's health route.

reject.why: Full node_modules in the runner instead of the traced standalone output.

evals.prompt: Our app needs NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY. Add it to the image build.

expect.why: Inlined at build, so it's a build argument.
Exposed to next build in the builder stage.

reject.why: A runtime ConfigMap value can't reach code inlined at build.

evals.prompt: We now install @acme/sdk from a private npm registry that needs a token. Make the Docker build work.

expect.why: The token comes in as a BuildKit secret.
The workflow passes the secret to build-push-action.

reject.why: A build arg stays in the image history.
A token written into a copied file.
An ENV with a secret ends up in the image.
